title: Obfuscated Activations as an Adversarial Bypass: Measuring the Gap Between Probe Accuracy and Adaptive Resistance

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Demonstrates limits of single-direction activation probes and motivates multi-layer or nonlinear detection strategies. Directly contributes to the adaptive defenses open problem with a concrete vulnerability characterization.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Replicating a linear probe on residual stream activations is feasible but requires activation extraction skills. Crafting obfuscation suffixes via greedy token search adds algorithmic complexity. Building a multi-layer ensemble probe is a stretch for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three phases: train probe, craft adversarial suffixes, build ensemble defense. Each is a mini-project. The greedy token search for obfuscation suffixes alone could take significant time. May exceed 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
